mission_10: Congratulations on completing the JavaScript chapter! You have built a complete module-based architecture with private state, validation, and a plugin system. The Module pattern demonstrates encapsulation, the Validator shows rule-based validation, and the Plugin system enables extensibility. Combined with everything you learned — variables, functions, arrays, objects, ES6+, promises, async/await, DOM manipulation, and events — you now have a comprehensive JavaScript foundation ready for any framework or library.
